t_tree_birch.name: birch tree
t_tree_birch.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Betula' genus, with the characteristic peeling bark.  Species like 'B. alleghaniensis', 'B. papyrifera', and 'B. populifolia' are the most common in the New England region.  You could tear off some strips of bark if you examined the tree more closely.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_birch_harvested.name: birch tree
t_tree_birch_harvested.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Betula' genus, with the characteristic peeling bark.  Species like 'B. alleghaniensis', 'B. papyrifera', and 'B. populifolia' are the most common in the New England region.  Looks like there isn't enough rhytidome to peel off yet.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_willow.name: willow tree
t_tree_willow.description: A tall, wide deciduous tree of the 'Salix' genus, with long thin leafy branches that hang down like curtains.  You could tear off some bark.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_willow_harvested.name: willow tree
t_tree_willow_harvested.description: A tall, wide deciduous tree of the 'Salix' genus, with long thin leafy branches that hang down like curtains.  Looks like all usable bark has been torn off, and new rhytidomes have not formed yet.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_maple.name: maple tree
t_tree_maple.description: A large deciduous tree of the 'Acer' genus.  The leaves are distinctively shaped with five prongs.  It could be tapped in order to extract maple syrup.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_maple_tapped.name: maple tree
t_tree_maple_tapped.description: A large deciduous tree of the 'Acer' genus.  The leaves are distinctively shaped with five prongs.  A spigot is wedged into the trunk, and sweet maple syrup can be extracted.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_hickory.name: hickory tree
t_tree_hickory.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Carya' genus.  You could look for hickory nuts if you examined the tree more closely.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_hickory_harvested.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Carya' genus.  It looks like the tree has been picked clean of hickory nuts.  You could cut it down with the right tools.
t_tree_hickory_harvested.name: hickory tree

t_tree_pistachio.name: pistachio tree
t_tree_pistachio.description: A deciduous tree of the 'Pistacia' genus.  This is a cultivated tree, and is not native to this region.  You could look for pistachio nuts if you examined the tree more closely.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_pistachio_harvested.name: pistachio tree
t_tree_pistachio_harvested.description: A deciduous tree of the 'Pistacia' genus.  This is a cultivated tree, and is not native to this region.  Unfortunately, it looks like it has been picked clean of pistachio nuts.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_almond.name: almond tree
t_tree_almond.description: A deciduous tree of the 'Prunus' genus.  This is a cultivated tree, and is not native to this region.  You could look for fresh almonds if you examined the tree more closely.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_almond_harvested.description: A deciduous tree of the 'Prunus' genus.  This is a cultivated tree, and is not native to this region.  There are no almonds left to pick on the tree.  You could cut it down with the right tools.
t_tree_almond_harvested.name: almond tree

t_tree_pecan.name: pecan tree
t_tree_pecan.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Carya' genus.  You could look for pecan nuts if you examined the tree more closely.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_pecan_harvested.name: pecan tree
t_tree_pecan_harvested.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Carya' genus.  It doesn't look like there are any pecan nuts left on the tree.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_hickory_dead.name: dead hickory tree
t_tree_hickory_dead.description: The dead remnants of a tall deciduous tree of the 'Carya' genus.  Nothing useful can be foraged from this poor, dead tree.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_underbrush.name: underbrush
t_underbrush.description: Small plants and shrubs that decorate the forest.  An observant forager could obtain edible plants, acorns, eggs, and mushrooms from it.

t_underbrush_harvested_spring.name: underbrush
t_underbrush_harvested_spring.description: Small plants and shrubs that decorate the forest.  It has been rummaged through and doesn't have anything useful left to forage from it.

t_underbrush_harvested_summer.name: underbrush
t_underbrush_harvested_summer.description: Small plants and shrubs that decorate the forest.  It has been rummaged through and doesn't have anything useful left to forage from it.

t_underbrush_harvested_autumn.name: underbrush
t_underbrush_harvested_autumn.description: Small plants and shrubs that decorate the forest.  It has been rummaged through and doesn't have anything useful left to forage from it.

t_underbrush_harvested_winter.name: underbrush
t_underbrush_harvested_winter.description: Small plants and shrubs that decorate the forest.  It has been rummaged through and doesn't have anything useful left to forage from it.  Frost covers it.

t_shrub_peanut.name: peanut bush
t_shrub_peanut.description: A small bush of crunchy peanuts.

t_shrub_peanut_harvested.name: peanut bush
t_shrub_peanut_harvested.description: A small peanut bush that's fruitless.

t_shrub_blueberry.name: blueberry bush
t_shrub_blueberry.description: A small bush of sweet blueberries.

t_shrub_blueberry_harvested.name: blueberry bush
t_shrub_blueberry_harvested.description: A small blueberry bush that's fruitless.

t_shrub_strawberry.name: strawberry bush
t_shrub_strawberry.description: A small bush of juicy strawberries.

t_shrub_strawberry_harvested.name: strawberry bush
t_shrub_strawberry_harvested.description: A small strawberry bush that's fruitless.

t_shrub_blackberry.name: blackberry bush
t_shrub_blackberry.description: A small bush of delicious blackberries.  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_blackberry_harvested.name: blackberry bush
t_shrub_blackberry_harvested.description: A small blackberry bush that's fruitless.  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_huckleberry.name: huckleberry bush
t_shrub_huckleberry.description: A small bush of huckleberries, often mistaken as blueberries.

t_shrub_huckleberry_harvested.name: huckleberry bush
t_shrub_huckleberry_harvested.description: A small huckleberry bush that's fruitless.

t_shrub_raspberry.name: raspberry bush
t_shrub_raspberry.description: A small bush of delicious raspberries.  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_raspberry_harvested.name: raspberry bush
t_shrub_raspberry_harvested.description: A small raspberry bush that's fruitless.  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_grape.name: grape bush
t_shrub_grape.description: A bush of a different species invaded by vines of grapes.

t_shrub_grape_harvested.name: grape bush
t_shrub_grape_harvested.description: A bush of a different species invaded by grape vines but they're fruitless.

t_shrub_rose.name: rose bush
t_shrub_rose.description: A fat bush of beautiful red roses, if only you could get a date!  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_rose_harvested.name: rose bush
t_shrub_rose_harvested.description: A fat rose bush that currently has no blooms.  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_hydrangea.name: hydrangea bush
t_shrub_hydrangea.description: A fat, bush of fragrant blue hydrangeas.

t_shrub_hydrangea_harvested.name: hydrangea bush
t_shrub_hydrangea_harvested.description: A fat hydrangea bush that currently has no blooms.

t_shrub_lilac.name: lilac bush
t_shrub_lilac.description: A wide, bush of bright pinkish purple lilacs.

t_shrub_lilac_harvested.name: lilac bush
t_shrub_lilac_harvested.description: A wide lilac bush that currently has no blooms.

t_trunk.name: tree trunk
t_trunk.description: A section of trunk from a tree that has been cut down.  Can be sawn into logs with the right tool.

t_lake_trunk.name: sunken tree trunk
t_lake_trunk.description: A section of trunk from a tree that has fallen from the shallows above and ended up down here at some point. It's waterlogged and seems to be partially eaten by worms.

t_stump.name: tree stump
t_stump.description: A tree stump, remnant of a tree that has been cut down.

t_woodchips.name: woodchips
t_woodchips.description: Small splinters of wood laid out in a layer to prevent unwanted plants from growing.

t_grass.name: grass
t_grass.description: An area of hardy Kentucky bluegrass about ankle high.  Cutting the grass short enough would destroy the root system, causing this area to turn into a patch of dirt.

t_grass_white.name: white grass
t_grass_white.description: A section of Kentucky bluegrass covered in white latex-based paint, with neat lines designed for recreational sports.

t_grass_long.name: long grass
t_grass_long.description: Long shaggy grass about shin high.

t_grass_dead.name: dead grass
t_grass_dead.description: Long shaggy grass that hasn't been cut recently.

t_grass_golf.name: golf green
t_grass_golf.description: Grass mowed very short and neat.

t_golf_hole.name: golf hole
t_golf_hole.description: A small plastic cup embedded in the grass.

t_fern.name: fern
t_fern.description: A short plant with thousands of leaves which grow in a fractal pattern from the stem.

t_fern_harvested.name: fern
t_fern_harvested.description: A short plant with thousands leaves which grow in a fractal pattern, without any curled shoots.

t_tree_cacao.name: cacao tree
t_tree_cacao.description: A thick tree belonging to the 'Theobroma' genus, native to Central and South America, that has been genetically engineered to withstand New England's four seasons.  If you examined the trunk of the tree, you could probably find some mature cacao pods.  Even in the face of apocalypse, you can't give up chocolate, of course.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_cacao_harvested.name: cacao tree
t_tree_cacao_harvested.description: A thick tree belonging to the 'Theobroma' genus, native to Central and South America, that has been genetically engineered to withstand New England's four seasons.  Looks like all the ripe cacao pods have been picked.  You could cut it down with the right tools.

t_tree_coca.name: coca plant
t_tree_coca.description: A tree native to South America, coca leaves have been used as medicine, tonic, and tea for thousands of years.  It was modified to withstand New England weather for medical research, only to be accidentally introduced to the wild.  If you examined the trunk of the tree, you could probably find some mature coca leaves.

t_tree_coca_harvested.name: harvested coca plant
t_tree_coca_harvested.description: A tree native to South America, coca leaves have been used as medicine, tonic, and tea for thousands of years.  Looks like all the coca leaves have been picked.

t_marloss.name: marloss bush
t_marloss.description: This alien plant superficially resembles a blueberry bush, and hangs with large, juicy pink pomes that emit a heady, fruity aroma.

t_fungus.name: fungal bed
t_fungus.description: Fungus grows thick here, obscuring the ground beneath it.

t_fungus_floor_in.name: fungal floor
t_fungus_floor_in.description: Grayish mold coats both the floor and the roof here, silent and still.  Stray spores waft through the air.

t_fungus_floor_sup.name: fungal floor
t_fungus_floor_sup.description: Grayish mold coats the floor here, silent and still.

t_fungus_floor_out.name: fungal floor
t_fungus_floor_out.description: Grayish mold coats the ground here, silent and still.

t_fungus_wall.name: fungal wall
t_fungus_wall.description: Several thick, large tendrils of fungus perforate the wall here, piercing straight through it from the outside.  Despite the apparent damage, the wall is still structurally sound.

t_fungus_wall_transformed.name: fungal wall
t_fungus_wall_transformed.description: The fungus here has grown thickly and tightly enough to form a solid wall.  It feels very stiff to the touch, and seems to be very strong.

t_fungus_mound.name: fungal mound
t_fungus_mound.description: A mound of fungal matter, intertwined in itself.

t_shrub_fungal.name: fungal shrub
t_shrub_fungal.description: This shrub has been completely absorbed by the mushrooms.  Its branches droop and have lost much of their structure, and its leaves have vanished, replaced by fleshy gray sacks that visibly expand and contract.

t_tree_fungal.name: fungal tree
t_tree_fungal.description: Once tall and majestic, this tree is now a slave to the fungus like the landscape around it.  Its bark is penetrated by and covered with fungal tendrils, and the canopy has rotted away, leaving only the branches, stretching forlornly to the sky as if to escape the infection overrunning it.

t_tree_fungal_young.name: young fungal tree
t_tree_fungal_young.description: A small sapling poking through the ground, infested by fungal mold.

t_marloss_tree.name: marloss tree
t_marloss_tree.description: This tree stands as a stark outlier to the landscape around it.  Despite its infestation, its leaves wave proudly in the wind, colored pinkish-white.  Its branches are heavy with pink fruit that looks both mutated and delicious.

t_pavement_hw_air.name: bridge pavement
t_pavement_hw_air.description: A bridge section made out of metal and concrete.

t_pavement_y_hw_air.name: bridge yellow pavement
t_pavement_y_hw_air.description: A bridge section made out of metal and concrete.  It's painted yellow.

t_sidewalk_hw_air.name: bridge sidewalk
t_sidewalk_hw_air.description: The sidewalk section of a concrete bridge.

t_water_sh.name: shallow water
t_water_sh.description: The water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_sh_underground.name: shallow water
t_water_sh_underground.description: The water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_dp.name: deep water
t_water_dp.description: You're having trouble seeing the bottom through the deep water here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_dp_underground.name: deep water
t_water_dp_underground.description: You're having trouble seeing the bottom through the deep water here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_murky.name: murky shallow water
t_water_murky.description: The water isn't too deep here but is murky with organic matter.  With a watertight container, you could gather fetid water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_sh_murky_underground.name: murky shallow water
t_water_sh_murky_underground.description: The water isn't too deep here but it is murky with organic matter.  With a watertight container, you could gather fetid water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_moving_sh.name: flowing shallow water
t_water_moving_sh.description: The streaming water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is, although probably safer than stagnant water.

t_water_moving_sh_underground.name: flowing shallow water
t_water_moving_sh_underground.description: The streaming water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is, although probably safer than stagnant water.

t_water_moving_dp.name: flowing deep water
t_water_moving_dp.description: The streaming water looks deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is, although probably safer than stagnant water.

t_water_moving_dp_underground.name: flowing deep water
t_water_moving_dp_underground.description: The streaming water looks deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is, although probably safer than stagnant water.

t_swater_sh.name: shallow water
t_swater_sh.description: The water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather salt water from here.

t_swater_sh_underground.name: shallow water
t_swater_sh_underground.description: The water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather salt water from here.

t_swater_dp.name: deep water
t_swater_dp.description: You're having trouble seeing the bottom through the deep water here.  With a watertight container, you could gather salt water from here.

t_swater_dp_underground.name: deep water
t_swater_dp_underground.description: You're having trouble seeing the bottom through the deep water here.  With a watertight container, you could gather salt water from here.

t_water_pool.name: pool water
t_water_pool.description: A deep pool full of water.  Never swim without a lifeguard present.  Even though monsters probably ate them.

t_water_pool_outdoors.name: pool water
t_water_pool_outdoors.description: A deep pool full of water.  Never swim without a lifeguard present.  Even though monsters probably ate them.

t_sewage.name: sewage
t_sewage.description: Gross.  Sewage water flows through here.  As if it needed saying, this isn't safe to drink.

t_lava.name: lava
t_lava.description: An extremely hot, glowing liquid, composed of molten rock and/or metal.  In some places, lava-grilled steak is a delicacy.

t_water_cube.name: submersed water
t_water_cube.description: You are submerged below the surface of the water, your feet can't touch the ground.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_lake_bed.name: lake bed
t_lake_bed.description: You are standing at the bottom of a body of fresh water.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_ocean_bed.name: ocean bed
t_ocean_bed.description: You are standing at the bottom of a body of salt water.  With a watertight container, you could gather salt water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_bulkhead_roof.name: bulkhead
t_bulkhead_roof.description: The top of a submerged structure.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_bulkhead_floor.name: bulkhead
t_bulkhead_floor.description: The interior of a submerged structure.  At least this part hasn't flooded yet.

t_bulkhead_floor_underwater.name: underwater bulkhead
t_bulkhead_floor_underwater.description: The interior of a submerged structure.  This part has been flooded.

t_bulkhead_floor_underwater_no_roof.name: underwater bulkhead
t_bulkhead_floor_underwater_no_roof.description: The interior of a submerged structure.  This part has been flooded.

t_lake_bed_concrete.name: submerged concrete
t_lake_bed_concrete.description: You are standing at the bottom of a body of fresh water on a pad of concrete.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_lake_bed_concrete_yellow.name: submerged concrete
t_lake_bed_concrete_yellow.description: You are standing at the bottom of a body of fresh water on a pad of concrete with yelllow paint.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_recycler.name: metal compactor
t_recycler.description: A hydraulic compactor that can accept items made of various metals, and press them into basic shapes, ready for further crafting.  If you're very careful, you can even uninstall it to transport it elsewhere.

t_gas_pump.name: gasoline pump
t_gas_pump.description: Precious GASOLINE.  The former world bowed to their petroleum god as it led them to their ruin.  There's plenty left over to fuel your inner road warrior.  If this gas dispenser doesn't give up the goods for free, you may have to pay at a nearby terminal.

t_gas_tank_smashed.name: broken fuel tank
t_gas_tank_smashed.description: A broken tank which was filled with gasoline.

t_gas_pump_a.name: gasoline pump
t_gas_pump_a.description: Precious GASOLINE.  The former world bowed to their petroleum god as it led them to their ruin.  There's plenty left over to fuel your inner road warrior.  If this gas dispenser doesn't give up the goods for free, you may have to pay at a nearby terminal.

t_gas_pump_smashed.name: smashed gas pump
t_gas_pump_smashed.description: The horror!  This gasoline pump has been destroyed, denying you access to the liquid gold.

t_diesel_pump.name: diesel pump
t_diesel_pump.description: This is a diesel fuel pump.  This roadside attraction provides all the thick, gloopy liquid POWER you need to move your sensibly oversized APOCOLYPTIC SUPERTRUCK from point A to points beyond.  If it doesn't dispense fuel immediately, try banging on it or grunt your way over the nearby payment terminal.

t_diesel_pump_smashed.name: smashed diesel pump
t_diesel_pump_smashed.description: You're not getting any diesel out of this pump any time soon.  Some barbarian decided to take their frustration out on it.

t_atm.name: ATM
t_atm.description: For your banking convenience, this Automated Teller Machine is fully capable of operating autonomously in the event of complete network failure.  You can deposit funds from cash cards and migrate all of your inflation-adjusted earnings to a single card.  These things have seen better days.  There's been a run on the bank, and this machine has the dents and cracks to prove it.

bash.sound: Critical failure imminent, self destruct activated.  Have a nice day!

t_ticket_vendor.name: ticket vendor
t_ticket_vendor.description: This machine has a little screen, and slots intended to take your money and provide you with a ticket.

t_ticket_machine.name: ticket machine
t_ticket_machine.description: This machine will provide you access to whatever is beyond it - for the price of a ticket, of course.

t_metal_ventilation_shutter.name: ventilation shutters
t_metal_ventilation_shutter.description: A large wall mounted panel, covered fragile metal sheets that regulate airflow.

t_generator_broken.name: broken generator
t_generator_broken.description: This generator is broken and will not help you produce usable electricity.

t_missile.name: missile
t_missile.description: This is a section of an ICBM, an Intercontinental Ballistic Missile.  This isn't the kind of rocket that goes to the moon.

t_missile_exploded.name: blown-out missile
t_missile_exploded.description: This is a section of an ICBM, an Intercontinental Ballistic Missile.  This isn't the kind of rocket that's going anywhere.

t_radio_tower.name: radio tower
t_radio_tower.description: This is the structure of a radio transmission tower.

t_radio_controls.name: radio controls
t_radio_controls.description: This console appears to control a nearby radio transmission tower.  It doesn't seem to be fully operational.

t_sewage_pipe.name: high gauge pipe
t_sewage_pipe.description: This is a section of high gauge pipe.

t_sewage_pump.name: high gauge pump
t_sewage_pump.description: This unpowered pump previously would have moved fluids around in a hurry.

t_cvdbody.name: CVD machine
t_cvdbody.description: The bulk of a highly technical-looking apparatus controlled by a nearby console.

t_nanofab_body.name: nanofabricator
t_nanofab_body.description: A great column of advanced machinery.  Within this self-contained, miniaturized factory, several 3d printers work in tandem with a robotic assembler to manufacture nearly any inorganic object.

t_nanofab.name: nanofabricator control panel
t_nanofab.description: A small computer panel attached to a nanofabricator.  It has a single slot for reading templates.

t_nanoforge_body.name: superalloy forge
t_nanoforge_body.description: A great column of advanced machinery.  Within this self-contained, miniaturized factory, several specialized 3d printers work in tandem with robotic forge units to efficiently manufacture superalloy sheets from steel sheets and nanomaterial.

t_nanoforge.name: superalloy forge control panel
t_nanoforge.description: A small computer panel attached to a superalloy forge.

t_vat.name: cloning vat
t_vat.description: A vat full of solution, probably intended to hold growing clones of people or other life forms.

t_slot_machine.name: slot machine
t_slot_machine.description: A machine with a bright screen flashing hypnotic promises of wealth.  If gambling with your life on a daily basis isn't enough for you, you can also gamble with this.

t_water_pump.name: water pump
t_water_pump.description: Deep well collecting ground water.  Installed water pump allows to draw water from it.

t_plut_generator.name: plutonium generator
t_plut_generator.description: This imposing apparatus harnesses the power of the atom, configured to provide nearly limitless backup power from the nuclear fuel installed in it.  It's not doing much good here though.  It has a complicated security system that is dangerous and difficult to bypass without authorization; a small slot suggests that it can accept some form of ID card.

t_sai_box.name: telecom cabinet
t_sai_box.description: A cabinet full of telecoms equipment.  With the lines down, you might be able to take it apart for its useful electronics.

t_sai_box_damaged.name: damaged telecom cabinet
t_sai_box_damaged.description: A damaged telecoms cabinet.  Might still be able to salvage some useful electronics scrap from it.

t_oil_circ_brkr_l.name: HV oil circuit breaker
t_oil_circ_brkr_l.description: A circuit breaker that uses oil in its arc suppression chamber.

t_oil_circ_brkr_s.name: small HV oil circuit breaker
t_oil_circ_brkr_s.description: A small circuit breaker that uses oil in its arc suppression chamber.

t_switchgear_l.name: large switchgear
t_switchgear_l.description: A switchgear panel.  It's covered in breaker switches, fuses, and gauges.

t_switchgear_s.name: small switchgear
t_switchgear_s.description: A small switchgear panel.  It's covered in breaker switches, fuses, and gauges.

t_lgtn_arrest.name: lightning arrester
t_lgtn_arrest.description: A component designed to protect insulation and conductors in an electrical system by directing lightning through itself and into the ground.

t_station_disc.name: disconnect switch
t_station_disc.description: A switch used to make sure an electrical system doesn't have any current flowing through it, for maintenance periods.

t_current_trans.name: current transformer
t_current_trans.description: An electronic component used to transform the voltage of a current.

t_potential_trans.name: potential transformer
t_potential_trans.description: A specialized type of electrical transformer,

t_conveyor.name: conveyor belt
t_conveyor.description: A conveyor belt.  Used to transport things.

t_machinery_light.name: light machinery
t_machinery_light.description: Assorted light machinery.  You could scavenge it for parts.

t_machinery_heavy.name: heavy machinery
t_machinery_heavy.description: Assorted heavy machinery.  You could scavenge it for parts.

t_machinery_old.name: old machinery
t_machinery_old.description: Assorted old machinery.  You could scavenge it for parts.

t_machinery_electronic.name: electronic machinery
t_machinery_electronic.description: Assorted electronic machinery.  You could scavenge it for parts.

t_milking_machine.name: milking machine
t_milking_machine.description: A machine used in the dairy industry to milk cows.

t_rootcellar.name: root cellar
t_rootcellar.description: A cellar dug into the earth for storing food in a cool environment.

t_covered_well.name: covered well
t_covered_well.description: Deep well collecting ground water.  Requires a method to draw water from.

t_improvised_shelter.name: improvised shelter
t_improvised_shelter.description: Improvised shelter providing little bit of protection, that can be used to take refuge from the elements, or conceal you from view.

t_leanto.name: pine lean-to
t_leanto.description: A small shelter roofed with pine leaves, that can be used to take refuge from the elements.

t_niter_bed_fresh.name: unfinished niter bed
t_niter_bed_fresh.description: A wet heap of fertilizer and plant matter covered in soil for traditional saltpeter production.  In about a season, enough potassium nitrate will leach through and crystallize to be harvestable.

t_niter_bed_ready.name: mature niter bed
t_niter_bed_ready.description: This heap of nitrated compost has leached out and crystallized a bunch of niter.  Dig here to extract it.

t_intercom.name: intercom
t_intercom.description: An intercom panel.  For when you want to scare the crap out of someone, or just talk to them over the intercom system, if you're boring like that.

t_card_robofac.name: card reader
t_card_robofac.description: This is a smartcard reader.  It sports the stylized symbol of an atom inside a flask that is universally known to indicate SCIENCE.  An ominous red LED reminds you of a robot gone haywire from an old sci-fi flick.  You could swipe a scientific ID badge near it if you do not fear the machine.

t_card_science.name: card reader
t_card_science.description: This is a smartcard reader.  It sports the stylized symbol of an atom inside a flask that is universally known to indicate SCIENCE.  The stark red LED blinks askance at your geek cred.  You could swipe a scientific ID badge near it to unlock the gates to discovery.

t_card_military.name: card reader
t_card_military.description: This is a smartcard reader.  The universal symbol of an eagle driving a tank, biting a grenade pin stands rampant in front of an American flag.  A small, red LED remains constant, as if watching you, waiting.  You could swipe a military ID card in front of the reader if you dared.

t_card_industrial.name: card reader
t_card_industrial.description: This is a smartcard reader.  The symbol of a gear in front of a bulging bicep is emblazoned on the matte black surface with an illegible heavy industrial company title.  A red LED blinks on the card reader.  Perhaps an industrial ID card could still open it.

t_card_fp.name: card reader
t_card_fp.description: This looks like the console controlling the security door, there's a pretty big reading surface on it.  You can see "Fp" soberly printed above the reader.  You have no idea what could open it.

t_card_reader_broken.name: broken card reader
t_card_reader_broken.description: This is a smartcard reader, but it doesn't seem to be functioning.  Probably because there's no more blinking red LED.

t_elevator_control.name: elevator controls
t_elevator_control.description: This is the control face for an elevator.  You could press the appropriate button to take you to your choice of floor.

t_elevator_control_no_roof.description: This is the control face for an elevator.  You could press the appropriate button to take you to your choice of floor.

t_elevator_control_off_no_roof.description: This is the control face for an elevator.  It's currently unpowered.

t_pedestal_wyrm.description: A dark stone pedestal covered in ancient, unintelligible symbols.  Looks ominous.

t_pedestal_temple.name: light pedestal
t_pedestal_temple.description: A light stone pedestal covered in ancient, unintelligible symbols.

t_nuclear_reactor.name: nuclear reactor core
t_nuclear_reactor.description: The critical infrastructure of a nuclear reactor.  If it was still running, it could produce enough steam to generate 125 megawatts of energy.  It could be salvaged for valuable components, which could be used to juryrig more smaller-scale sources of nuclear power.

t_wall_resin.name: resin wall
t_wall_resin.description: This wall is made of a glistening, nearly opaque, plastic-like substance.  Deep within the material making it up, you can barely see a network of pulsating green conduits, snaking like blood vessels through it.  The material is hard, warm to the touch, and slightly damp.

t_wall_resin_cage.name: resin cage
t_wall_resin_cage.description: This resin wall opens into a series of small honeycomb-like hexagons, allowing the passage of air and light.  While still made of the same sturdy material, it is thinner and more delicate in appearance.

t_floor_resin.name: resin floor
t_floor_resin.description: This nearly opaque, plastic-like floor has a gentle curve from wall to wall, but in the central areas is quite flat.  The material is hard, warm to the touch, and slightly damp.

t_platform_resin.name: resin floor
t_platform_resin.description: This nearly opaque, plastic-like floor is smooth and flat.  The material is hard, warm to the touch, and slightly damp.

t_resin_roof.name: resin roof
t_resin_roof.description: A wide, domed section of nearly opaque, plastic-like material.  When the light hits it, a network of multicolored conduits like blood vessels can be seen snaking through its glistening interior.

t_resin_hole_c.name: closed resin portal
t_resin_hole_c.description: A tricuspid hatch of some sort of damp, flexible, resinous material.  This one is closed tightly, but it looks like a firm push would cause it to snap open.

t_resin_hole_o.name: open resin portal
t_resin_hole_o.description: A tricuspid hatch of some sort of damp, flexible, resinous material.  This one is open, the flaps held out by some sort of stringy mucus-like substance.

t_resin_hole.name: resin-lined hole
t_resin_hole.description: An open hole in the resin wall, large enough to pass through.

t_dimensional_portal.name: dimensional portal
t_dimensional_portal.description: The portal that started it all.  A dimly shimmering, completely opaque mist, jet black at the edges, and deep red in the center.  A nuclear explosive placed inside may destabilize and close it.  Alternatively, you may be able to close it from the other side.

t_nether_glass_wall.name: void wall
t_nether_glass_wall.description: A perfectly smooth wall that looks like a window into the void.

t_nether_glass_floor.name: shifting floor

t_railroad_rubble.description: A small mallet that a judge uses to call - er, wait.  Oh, gravel!  Gravel is a collection of small stones often used for roads, as railroad ballast, and in many other applications.

t_roof_paper_hard.description: A flat surface made of hardened pulpy mass, covered in sticky wasp saliva.

t_web_bridge.name: web bridge
t_web_bridge.description: A hammock like bridge spun from spider silk.

t_treetop.name: treetop
t_treetop.description: The upper branches of a tree.  There's just enough room to perch here.

t_treetop_evergreen.name: treetop
t_treetop_evergreen.description: The upper branches of a tree.  There's just enough room to perch here.

t_treetop_dead.name: dead treetop
t_treetop_dead.description: The bare upper branches of a dead tree.  There's just enough room to perch here.

t_pit_shallow.name: shallow pit
t_pit_shallow.description: A pit that could be dug even deeper or filled up.  Also useful as a starting foundation for some constructions.

t_pit.name: pit
t_pit.description: A steep hole that could seriously injure something if it fell in, potentially fatal if it was filled with sharp and dangerous things.  Deep enough for more advanced construction projects, and possibly to reach groundwater if constructed properly.

t_pit_corpsed.name: corpse filled pit
t_pit_corpsed.description: A giant trench full of corpses, maybe even a mass graveyard.  The bodies could be dug out but none of it looks remotely usable.

t_pit_covered.name: covered pit
t_pit_covered.description: A deep pit with a two by four placed across it, looks sturdy enough to cross safely or the plank could be removed to turn it back into trap fall.

t_pit_spiked.name: spiked pit
t_pit_spiked.description: A narrow trench full of very pointy things that would easily puncture a body.

t_pit_spiked_covered.name: covered spiked pit
t_pit_spiked_covered.description: Menacing with sharp spears along the bottom, this pit has a plank across it to allow someone or something to cross safely.  The two by four could be removed to revert it back into a trap.

t_pit_glass.name: glass pit
t_pit_glass.description: Looks like a ton of broken glass was dumped into this pit, maybe not fatal to fall in but wouldn't be pleasant to try to crawl out.

t_pit_glass_covered.name: covered glass pit
t_pit_glass_covered.description: A two by four has been placed carefully to allow traversal over this ditch full of large glass shards.  The wooden board could be removed so it couldn't be safely crossed.

t_slime.name: slime
t_slime.description: A disgusting and slippery mess that could be used to stash things because who'd want to touch it?

t_triffid_bark_wall.name: solid bark wall
t_triffid_bark_wall.description: A solid wall of bark, enclosing the trunk of a massive tree.  It will probably burn quite well.

t_bark_wall_chipped.name: chipped bark wall
t_bark_wall_chipped.description: A solid wall of bark enclosing the trunk of a massive tree.  Some of it has been broken away.

t_bark_wall_broken.name: broken bark wall
t_bark_wall_broken.description: A formerly solid wall of bark, now almost completely destroyed and waiting to collapse.

t_triffid_wood_wall.name: solid wood wall
t_triffid_wood_wall.description: A solid wall of naturally grown wood.  Likely very flammable.

t_barkfloor.name: bark
t_barkfloor.description: A solid piece of bark covers the floor here.

t_triffid_leaves.name: branches with leaves
t_triffid_leaves.description: Thin branches emerge here, covered with thick, large leaves.

t_root_floor.name: root floor
t_root_floor.description: A dirt floor covered with roots.

t_triffid_slope_down.name: downward root slope
t_triffid_slope_down.description: A downward-facing slope of root-covered dirt.

t_triffid_slope_up.name: upward root slope
t_triffid_slope_up.description: An upward-facing slope of root-covered dirt.

t_bramble_door_c.name: closed bramble roots
t_bramble_door_c.description: A bramble of roots can be seen here, covering a hole.  They could easily be pulled apart.

t_bramble_door_o.name: open bramble roots
t_bramble_door_o.description: A bramble of roots can be seen here, they have been pulled apart to reveal a hole.

t_wall.name: plastered wooden wall
t_wall.description: The stereotypical wall with wooden support structure filled with insulation and drywalled.  Paint job is the all too common and neutral off-white or cream color, it could use more vibrant paint.  The underlying material is still somewhat flammable.

t_wall_paintable.name: dark plastered wooden wall
t_wall_paintable.description: The stereotypical wall with wooden support structure filled with insulation and drywalled.  Paint job is by default is the all too common and neutral off-white, but it is simple and easy to paint with spray cans.  The underlying material is still somewhat flammable.

t_wall_half.name: half-built wooden wall
t_wall_half.description: An incomplete wall of refined wood, dotted with carefully placed nails to provide proper support.  It requires some more two by fours and nails before it'd be considered a suitable wall.

t_wall_paintable_half.name: half-built wooden wall
t_wall_paintable_half.description: An incomplete wall of refined wood, dotted with carefully placed nails to provide proper support.  It requires some more two by fours and nails before it'd be considered a suitable wall.

t_wall_half_domestic.name: half-built domestic wall
t_wall_half_domestic.description: Wooden slats nailed across the bare skeleton of what will eventually be a modern interior wall.  The finishing touches would typically be drywall or plaster, or whatever one can improvise out of local materials.

t_ponywall.name: pony wall
t_ponywall.description: A short divider wall with wooden support structure with drywall.  Paint job is the all too common and neutral off-white or cream color.  Appears as though the material is flammable.

t_brick_wall_halfway.name: half-built brick wall
t_brick_wall_halfway.description: Half of a brick wall, looks like it still requires some more resources and effort before being considered a real wall.

t_brick_wall.name: brick wall
t_brick_wall.description: A solid brick wall, sturdy enough to support a roof with enough walls and keep out any unwanted visitors.

t_rock_wall_half.name: half-built stone wall
t_rock_wall_half.description: Half of a sturdy stone wall.  Some work still needs to be done before this stone wall is complete.

t_rock_smooth.name: smoothed rock
t_rock_smooth.description: A block of stone that's been smoothed and shaped, commonly granite or marble for funerary chapels and mausoleums.

t_adobe_brick_wall_halfway.name: half-built adobe wall
t_adobe_brick_wall_halfway.description: Half of an adobe brick wall, looks like it still requires some more resources and effort before being considered a real wall.

t_adobe_brick_wall.name: adobe wall
t_adobe_brick_wall.description: A solid adobe brick wall, sturdy enough to support a roof with enough walls and keep out any unwanted visitors.

t_concrete_wall.name: concrete wall
t_concrete_wall.description: An aesthetically pleasing design with simple lines, this type of concrete was used with a weaker chemical mixture in order to have faster setting times.  Not ideal for multi-story buildings, but still capable of supporting a roof.

t_wall_metal.name: metal wall
t_wall_metal.description: An industrially fabricated thick sheet carefully positioned and joined seamlessly with perimeter sealant, this wall is capable of resisting extreme elements as well as hostile forces.  Blast load rated and extremely fire-retardant, breaching will require specialized tools or industrial vehicles.

t_wall_bulkhead.name: bulkhead
t_wall_bulkhead.description: An industrially fabricated thick sheet carefully positioned, this wall is capable of resisting extreme elements as well as hostile forces.

t_wall_bulkhead_underwater.name: underwater bulkhead
t_wall_bulkhead_underwater.description: An industrially fabricated thick sheet carefully positioned, this wall is capable of resisting extreme elements as well as hostile forces.  Seems to have sprung a leak, however.

t_sconc_wall.name: simple concrete wall
t_sconc_wall.description: A durable and uniform concrete wall, quite drab without decoration.  More than capable of supporting a roof, as well as keeping out most anything, save for vehicles.

t_sconc_wall_halfway.name: half-built simple concrete wall
t_sconc_wall_halfway.description: A partially poured concrete wall that could probably keep anything behind it quite safe if it were finished.

t_strconc_wall.name: reinforced concrete wall
t_strconc_wall.description: An extremely resilient wall, filled with concrete and rebar.  Best suited for supporting multi-level buildings, only serious explosives and high-speed impacts would be capable of damaging this wall.

t_strconc_wall_halfway.name: half-built reinforced concrete wall
t_strconc_wall_halfway.description: Poured concrete with methodically placed rebar sticking out, which isn't practical for supporting roofs or shelter.  It appears to need more resources before being considered complete.

t_reb_cage.name: rebar cage
t_reb_cage.description: A structural support system made of rebar that appears to be the early stages of a reinforced concrete wall, just missing the poured concrete.

t_scrap_wall.name: simple metal wall
t_scrap_wall.description: A relatively simple wall made of scraped together metal.  It's still capable of blocking intruders and supporting a roof with adjacent walls.

t_scrap_wall_halfway.name: half-built simple metal wall
t_scrap_wall_halfway.description: A partially built makeshift wall of metal that could potentially support a roof if it were completed.

t_screened_porch_wall.name: screen mesh wall
t_screened_porch_wall.description: A rather flimsy tall wall made of 2x4s and screen mesh, suitable for keeping the bugs out.

t_wall_wood.name: wooden wall
t_wall_wood.description: A finished wall of planks and support beams, capable of supporting an upper level or roof.  Still highly flammable.

t_wall_wood_chipped.name: chipped wood wall
t_wall_wood_chipped.description: A wall of aligned two by fours that's starting to crack and break open.  Some cut wood and a number of nails could patch this up quick.

t_wall_wood_broken.name: broken wood wall
t_wall_wood_broken.description: A number of planks are missing and the structure is beginning to sag and fall apart.  It's going to need quite a bit of work to repair this wall.

t_wall_wood_underwater.name: underwater wooden wall
t_wall_wood_underwater.description: A decaying old section of wooden wall, soaked through and leaking.  It will likely crumble to bits if damaged.

t_wall_log_half.name: half-built log wall
t_wall_log_half.description: A half-constructed wall of notched logs that interlock to provide stability.  Needs a few more logs to hold up a roof.  Looks flammable.

t_wall_log.name: log wall
t_wall_log.description: A tall wall of timber suitable for housing and insulating from the weather.  Quite flammable.

t_wall_log_chipped.name: chipped log wall
t_wall_log_chipped.description: A moderately damaged wall, could probably be patched up with some planks and nails.

t_wall_log_broken.name: broken log wall
t_wall_log_broken.description: A destroyed wood wall, with only a supporting log left, ready to collapse.  Looks repairable if the damage was replaced and patched together with nails and planks.

t_palisade.name: palisade wall
t_palisade.description: An age-old type of fortification consisting of hefty lumber staked into the ground and cabled together.

t_wall_wattle.name: wattle-and-daub wall
t_wall_wattle.description: A relatively primitive wall made by daubing together a lattice of wooden strips using some combination of wet soil, clay, sand, animal dung and straw.

t_wall_wattle_broken.name: broken wattle-and-daub wall
t_wall_wattle_broken.description: This wattle-and-daub wall section has been destroyed, leaving mostly just frame, and is barely held together.

t_wall_wattle_half.name: half-built wattle-and-daub wall
t_wall_wattle_half.description: This wattle-and-daub wall has some of the wooden strip lattice in place, and still requires the rest of the lattice and supporting wet compound to be filled in.

t_wall_dirt.name: smooth dirt wall
t_wall_dirt.description: A solid wall of compressed dirt, mixed with… something to keep it stable.  Its surface glistens slightly, and it smells like rotten milk.

t_junk_wall.name: junk metal wall
t_junk_wall.description: A wall of rusty scrap metal bolted and wire-tied to a sturdy frame.  Very fashionable in post-apocalyptic shantytowns.  Can support a roof.

t_wall_rammed_earth.name: rammed earth wall
t_wall_rammed_earth.description: A solid wall of compressed dirt, sturdy enough to support a roof with enough walls and keep out some unwanted visitors.

t_junk_palisade.name: junk metal barrier
t_junk_palisade.description: A short wall of rusty scrap metal bolted and wire-tied to a makeshift frame.  Very fashionable in post-apocalyptic shantytowns.  This one isn't quite strong enough to support a roof, but could be reinforced.

t_wall_glass.name: glass wall
t_wall_glass.description: A barrier made of glass, it's nothing complicated, and looks extremely fragile.  Some contain glass break sensors or window sensors that trigger if the glass is tampered.

t_wall_glass_alarm.name: glass wall
t_wall_glass_alarm.description: A barrier made of glass, it's nothing complicated, and looks extremely fragile.  Some contain glass break sensors or window sensors that trigger if the glass is tampered.

t_laminated_glass.name: laminated glass
t_laminated_glass.description: Laminated glass is composed layers of glass and plastic held together by an interlayer.

t_ballistic_glass.name: ballistic glass
t_ballistic_glass.description: Ballistic glass consists of layers of laminated glass.

t_reinforced_glass.name: reinforced glass
t_reinforced_glass.description: A thicker pane of glass with thin metal wires embedded throughout, strengthening the structural properties.  It's a lot stronger than drywall, but it's not made to support a roof and is weaker than concrete.

t_reinforced_glass_shutter.name: reinforced glass with closed shutters
t_reinforced_glass_shutter.description: A secondary layer of protection over reinforced glass, these metal shutters are typically used to ward off criminals or protect against damage from extreme weather.  Looks like it can only be opened from the inside.  Even with the installed shutters, it isn't feasible in supporting a roof.

t_reinforced_glass_shutter_open.name: reinforced glass with open shutters
t_reinforced_glass_shutter_open.description: Hanging metal shutters that haven't been deployed, exposing the reinforced glass.  It appears as though the metal shutters can only be activated from the inside.

t_bars.name: metal bars
t_bars.description: Thick, heavy bars from the floor to the ceiling, interlaced wall to wall.  Not made to support roofs, but great for blocking paths.

t_paper.name: paper wall
t_paper.description: A huge wall of pulpy mass, covered in sticky wasp saliva.  You could smash it down effortlessly.

t_paper_brood.name: paper wall
t_paper_brood.description: A huge wall of pulpy mass, covered in sticky wasp saliva.  You could smash it down effortlessly.

t_paper_hard.name: layered paper wall
t_paper_hard.description: A thick wall of layered tree pulp and wasp saliva, hardened to withstand the elements.  You could break through this, but it won't be easy.

t_root_wall.name: root wall
t_root_wall.description: A dirt wall covered with roots.

t_wax.name: wax wall
t_wax.description: A wall made entirely out of wax.

t_rock.name: solid rock
t_rock.description: It's solid rock, could be full of all kinds of interesting things.  Best grab your pickaxe or equivalent digging implement, and strike the earth!

t_rock_ore_iron.name: iron ore vein
t_rock_ore_iron.description: Solid rock, with an exposed seam of reddish-brown iron ore.

t_rock_ore_banded_iron.name: banded-iron ore vein
t_rock_ore_banded_iron.description: Solid rock, with an exposed seam of brown-red banded-iron ore.

t_rock_ore_copper.name: copper ore vein
t_rock_ore_copper.description: Solid rock, with an exposed seam of green copper ore.

t_rock_ore_tetrahedrite.name: tetrahedrite ore vein
t_rock_ore_tetrahedrite.description: Solid rock, with an exposed seam of grey tetrahedrite ore.

t_rock_ore_chalcopyrite.name: chalcopyrite ore vein
t_rock_ore_chalcopyrite.description: Solid rock, with an exposed seam of light-green chalcopyrite ore.

t_rock_ore_lead.name: lead ore vein
t_rock_ore_lead.description: Solid rock, with an exposed dull gray and yellow seam of lead ore.

t_rock_ore_galena.name: galena ore vein
t_rock_ore_galena.description: Solid rock, with an exposed dull gray seam of galena ore.

t_rock_ore_galenau.name: galenau ore vein
t_rock_ore_galenau.description: Solid rock, with an exposed yellow-grey seam of galenau ore.

t_rock_ore_tin.name: tin ore vein
t_rock_ore_tin.description: Solid rock, with dark gray hints of what you're fairly certain is an ore of tin.

t_rock_ore_coppin.name: coppin ore vein
t_rock_ore_coppin.description: Solid rock, with a seeming mixture of copper and tin ore.

t_rock_ore_bronzium.name: bronzium ore vein
t_rock_ore_bronzium.description: Solid rock, with a seeming mixture of copper and tin ore. Faintly resembles crude bronze.

t_rock_ore_silver.name: silver ore vein
t_rock_ore_silver.description: Solid rock, with an exposed gray gleam of silver ore.  There might be a few bits of native silver hidden within, but most of it will need to be processed.

t_rock_ore_gold.name: gold vein
t_rock_ore_gold.description: Hot damn, you've struck gold!  Gleaming through the rock in its native form, it's almost enough to make one forget how much less valuable it is after the end of the world.

t_rock_ore_electrumite.name: electrumite ore vein
t_rock_ore_electrumite.description: Solid rock, with an exposed silvered yellow gleam of electrumite ore.

t_column_halfway.name: half-built column
t_column_halfway.description: An empty wooden frame in the shape of a column, built around a concrete and rebar foundation.  It isn't capable of supporting roofs or shelter, and appears to need more resources before being considered complete.

t_drystone_wall.name: field stone wall
t_drystone_wall.description: A sturdy dry stone wall.  Just rocks fitted together without mortar.

t_drystone_wall_half.name: field stone half-wall
t_drystone_wall_half.description: A half height sturdy dry stone wall.  Just rocks fitted together without mortar.  Complete as is or with extensive work it could be doubled in height.

t_pillar.name: pillar
t_pillar.description: A concrete column that helps keep the mine's ceiling and walls from collapsing.

t_fortification_wood.name: wooden fortification
t_fortification_wood.description: A wooden wall with a firing hole carved out of it, which you can fire through unimpeded if you're adjacent to it.  It doesn't take much out of incoming fire, but it's better than nothing.

t_fortification_wood_underwater.name: underwater wooden fortification
t_fortification_wood_underwater.description: A waterlogged gunport from the age of sail.  If you have a speargun to fire through it with, it might still serve as light cover against any unexpected encounters with gun-toting sharks.

t_fortification_log.name: log fortification
t_fortification_log.description: Stout timbers with a firing hole carved into it, letting you fire unimpeded if you're adjacent to it.  Provides pretty good cover, but might falter against higher-end firepower.

t_fortification_drystone.name: field stone fortification
t_fortification_drystone.description: A sturdy dry stone wall with a firing hole chiseled out, letting you fire unhindered when adjacent to it.  Basic as it may be, simple stones provide effective cover.

t_fortification_stone.name: stone fortification
t_fortification_stone.description: A sturdy stone wall with a firing hole chiseled out, letting you fire unhindered when adjacent to it.  An excellent source of cover against anything short of siege weapons.

t_fortification_brick.name: brick fortification
t_fortification_brick.description: A solid brick wall with a firing hole built into it, providing an opening to shoot through unimpeded while adjacent to it.  A sturdy source of cover against incoming fire.

t_fortification_adobe.name: adobe fortification
t_fortification_adobe.description: A solid adobe brick wall with a firing hole built into it, providing an opening to fire through when adjacent to it.  Fairly solid cover against muskets and most small arms alike.

t_fortification_domestic.name: plastered wooden fortification
t_fortification_domestic.description: A wooden wall faced with plaster, with a firing hole punched into it.  You can fire through unimpeded if you're adjacent to it.  It might slow incoming fire down a bit if it hits the support beams, but don't count on it.

t_fortification_domestic_r.name: plastered red fortification
t_fortification_domestic_r.description: A plastered wooden wall painted red, with a firing hole punched into it.  You can fire through unimpeded if you're adjacent to it.  It might slow incoming fire down a bit if it hits the support beams, but don't count on it.

t_fortification_domestic_y.description: A plastered wooden wall painted yellow, with a firing hole punched into it.  You can fire through unimpeded if you're adjacent to it.  It might slow incoming fire down a bit if it hits the support beams, but don't count on it.

t_fortification_domestic_P.description: A plastered wooden wall painted pink, with a firing hole punched into it.  You can fire through unimpeded if you're adjacent to it.  It might slow incoming fire down a bit if it hits the support beams, but don't count on it.

t_fortification_domestic_p.name: plastered purple fortification
t_fortification_domestic_p.description: A plastered wooden wall painted purple, with a firing hole punched into it.  You can fire through unimpeded if you're adjacent to it.  It might slow incoming fire down a bit if it hits the support beams, but don't count on it.

t_window.name: window
t_window.description: A giant sheet of glass inserted into a window, typically found on the side of shops to showcase goods.

t_window_taped.name: taped window
t_window_taped.description: Duct tape covers this window, blocking sunlight and visibility.  You could remove the duct tape by cutting it off.

t_window_domestic.name: window with curtains
t_window_domestic.description: A window with fancy curtains on the inside that can be drawn closed to block visibility and shut out any light.

pry.fail_message: You pry, but cannot pry open the window.

t_window_no_curtains.name: window without curtains
t_window_no_curtains.description: A smaller window typically found in residential homes.  You could install a curtain rod and drapes if you had the supplies and skill.

pry.fail_message: You pry, but cannot pry open the window.

t_window_no_curtains_open.name: open window without curtains
t_window_no_curtains_open.description: A smaller window typically found in residential homes.  It's open and can be crawled through.

t_window_no_curtains_taped.name: taped window
t_window_no_curtains_taped.description: A smaller window typically found in residential homes.  This one has been blocked out with duct tape.  You could remove the duct tape by cutting it off.

t_window_empty_taped.name: taped window
t_window_empty_taped.description: An empty window.  This one has been blocked out with duct tape.  You could remove the duct tape by cutting it off.

t_window_empty_domestic_taped.name: taped window
t_window_empty_domestic_taped.description: An empty window.  This one has been blocked out with duct tape.  You could remove the duct tape by cutting it off.

t_wall_glass_taped.name: taped glass wall
t_wall_glass_taped.description: A glass wall.  This one has been blocked out with duct tape.  You could remove the duct tape by cutting it off.

t_wall_glass_alarm_taped.name: taped glass wall
t_wall_glass_alarm_taped.description: A glass wall.  This one has been blocked out with duct tape.  You could remove the duct tape by cutting it off.

t_window_domestic_taped.name: taped window
t_window_domestic_taped.description: A window with fancy curtains on the inside.  This one has been blocked out with duct tape.  You could remove the duct tape by cutting it off.

t_window_open.name: open window with curtains
t_window_open.description: A window with fancy curtains on the inside that can be drawn closed to block visibility and shut out any light.  It's open and you can crawl through.

t_curtains.name: window with closed curtains
t_curtains.description: A window with fancy curtains that have been drawn shut, blocking sunlight and visibility.  The curtains can only be opened on the inside.  If you examined the curtains more closely, you could peek through the drapes or tear down everything.  Or you could just smash the window open.

pry.fail_message: You pry, but cannot pry open the window.

t_window_alarm.name: window
t_window_alarm.description: A giant sheet of glass inserted into a window, typically found on the side of shops to showcase goods.

t_window_alarm_taped.name: taped window
t_window_alarm_taped.description: Duct tape covers this window, blocking out any sunlight and visibility.  You could remove the duct tape by cutting it off.

t_window_empty.name: empty window
t_window_empty.description: An empty window frame consisting of two by fours and nails.  You could install a sheet of glass, or even board it up for protection.  You could also convert it into a wall if you took the time to construct it.

t_window_empty_domestic.name: empty domestic window
t_window_empty_domestic.description: An empty window frame consisting of two by fours and nails.  You could install a sheet of glass, or even board it up for protection.  You could also convert it into a wall if you took the time to construct it.

t_window_frame.name: window frame
t_window_frame.description: A wooden window frame that has shattered glass around it.  You'll probably get hurt if you crawled through the sharp and jagged shards.  You could smash out the remaining pieces, or take your time and quietly clean them up.

t_window_frame_domestic.name: domestic window frame
t_window_frame_domestic.description: A wooden window frame that has shattered glass around it.  You'll probably get hurt if you crawled through the sharp and jagged shards.  You could smash out the remaining pieces, or take your time and quietly clean them up.

t_window_boarded.name: boarded up window
t_window_boarded.description: A glass window that has been covered with nailed down planks, blocking sunlight and visibility.  It's not much stronger, but it could be further reinforced with strategically placed two by fours.

t_window_boarded_noglass.name: boarded up window
t_window_boarded_noglass.description: An empty window frame that has been covered with nailed down planks, blocking sunlight and visibility.  It's not much stronger, but it could be further reinforced with strategically placed two by fours.

t_window_reinforced.name: reinforced boarded up window
t_window_reinforced.description: A heavily fortified glass window with carefully placed planks across the glass to block vision.  Adding a few spikes and metal plating would further increase its durability.

t_window_reinforced_noglass.name: reinforced boarded up window
t_window_reinforced_noglass.description: A heavily fortified window with carefully placed planks across the open frame to block vision.  Adding a few spikes and metal plating would further increase its durability.

t_window_enhanced.name: armored boarded up window
t_window_enhanced.description: This once normal glass window now menaces with spikes along the edges, with laboriously placed metal sheeting to further strengthen the wooden reinforcements underneath.

t_window_enhanced_noglass.name: armored boarded up window
t_window_enhanced_noglass.description: This once normal window frame now menaces with spikes along the edges, with laboriously placed metal sheeting to further strengthen the wooden reinforcements underneath.

t_window_bars.name: window frame with metal bars
t_window_bars.description: A window frame with thick security grilles, making it impossible to crawl through.  Typically installed for high-value stores, or at least stores in bad neighborhoods.

t_window_bars_alarm.name: window with metal bars
t_window_bars_alarm.description: A giant sheet of glass inserted into a window with thick security grilles, making it impossible to crawl through.  Typically installed for high-value stores, or at least stores in bad neighborhoods.  This one has a small sticker in a corner stating, 'Protected by AtmoWeb, leading AI in terminating crime'.

t_window_bars_curtains.name: window with metal bars and curtains
t_window_bars_curtains.description: A barred window with fancy curtains that have been drawn shut, blocking sunlight and visibility.  The curtains can only be opened on the inside.  If you examined the curtains more closely, you could peek through the drapes or tear down everything.

t_window_bars_domestic.name: window with metal bars and curtains
t_window_bars_domestic.description: A giant sheet of glass inserted into a window with thick security grilles, making it impossible to crawl through.  Typically installed for high-value stores, or at least stores in bad neighborhoods.  This one has been retrofitted with curtains.

t_window_stained_green.name: high stained glass window
t_window_stained_green.description: Breathtaking craftsmanship of stained glass featuring an elegant emerald landscape.

t_window_stained_red.name: high stained glass window
t_window_stained_red.description: Breathtaking craftsmanship of stained glass featuring an otherworldly radiant ruby flower blooming.

t_window_stained_blue.name: high stained glass window
t_window_stained_blue.description: Breathtaking craftsmanship of stained glass featuring an alluring azure oceanic abyss.

t_metal_grate_window.name: Window with metal grate
t_metal_grate_window.description: Metal bars made into a grate for a window, highly durable and will stand against any foe.

t_metal_grate_window_with_curtain.description: Metal bars made into a grate for a window with a closed curtain, highly durable and will stand against any foe.

t_reinforced_plastic_window_with_curtain.description: An open makeshift window with a opened curtain.  Comprising three sheets of translucent, rigid plastic secured in a wooden frame.  It'll do in a pinch.

t_tempered_glass_open.description: A giant sheet of tempered glass inserted into a window frame.

t_tempered_glass_with_curtain_open.description: A tempered window with fancy curtains on the inside that can be drawn closed to block visibility and shut out any light.
